### Historical audit — S0173

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/selection/commons_133800864/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to its JSONL lines. The supplied observations contain no split lines.

| Stage | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The student was asked to reconstruct one 384 × 512 indoor photograph with separate meshes and matching viewpoint, framing, materials and occlusions, without using the image as a background or texture. No calibrated geometry or other views were available (line 1, student `model_request`). The code’s “kitchen corner” interpretation is the student’s inference, not an independently inspected reference. |
| Construction | The student authored and executed a multi-object scene: wall, counter, cabinets, window and blinds, sink, towel and holder, blender, pitcher and jug. The program specifies granite noise/bump, metal, paper, cloth and transmissive cup materials; a jug assembly, handles and towel-ring components; a leaning cup and tilted lid; camera and lights (lines 3–4, student response and step 1 `execute`; lines 13–14, revised response and step 3 `execute`). These operations establish intended parts and poses, not verified contact or reference fidelity. |
| Failures and repair | Step 1 failed before rendering: sink fillet radius exceeded half the smallest dimension (line 5, `execution_result`). After receiving that error in line 6, the student reduced thin-component radii, including the pitcher base (lines 8–9); step 2 progressed but failed because the scene world was `None` (line 10). The next request included that error (line 11); step 3 created a world if absent and changed camera target and lens from 65 to 78 (lines 13–14). Both were substantive executed revisions, not empty patches. |
| Validation and outcome | Step 3 reported `ok: true`, saved a render and blend file, and was selected (lines 15–16). The render log reports 16 samples although the program requested 48; the cause is not shown. The subsequent student request included both reference and rendered image with zero executions remaining; the student replied `DONE` (lines 17–19). This is **technical build/render success**, not independent visual or geometric verification of reconstruction quality. |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher message, diagnosis or proposed update appears in this student trajectory; no teacher receipt or adoption can be established. The student independently produced and revised programs in response to runner tracebacks. Session records report zero tool calls, so no separate autonomous tool exploration is visible (lines 2, 7, 12, 18). |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, execution feedback identified an API dimension constraint and an uninitialized world; the subsequent revisions overcame those observed blockers. The particular kitchen objects, coordinates, textures and camera choices are task-specific. Whether the intended materials were actually assigned as expected, parts connected convincingly, poses and occlusions matched, or camera and lighting reproduced the photograph remains unresolved: neither image’s pixels are included in this audit. A successful render and `DONE` do not settle those hypotheses.
